$comment: Machine-readable tweak database. Tools and AI agents can parse this instead of scraping markdown. Every entry carries a verdict, the condition under which it applies, and a risk rating. See AGENTS.md for the rules on using it.

verdicts.keep: Measured benefit. Apply if the condition matches.
verdicts.remove: No benefit or actively harmful. Remove if present.
verdicts.reject: Commonly recommended, does not survive measurement.

risk.medium: Has a real failure mode under some conditions.
risk.critical: Can prevent the machine from booting.

tweaks.name: SvcHostSplitThresholdInKB
tweaks.reason: Setting this at or above installed RAM forces all services into shared svchost processes. DcomLaunch, LSM and Power then share a PID with PlugPlay and DeviceInstall; any fault there kills a critical process and bugchecks 0xEF. Zero performance benefit - it is a RAM-saving setting for low-memory machines.
tweaks.evidence: 19 svchost instances when broken vs 55 after fix. Boot loop with bugcheck 0x000000EF.

tweaks.name: Core parking min cores, Efficiency Class 1 (P-cores)
tweaks.reason: Hybrid CPUs have separate parking settings per efficiency class. Class 1 (P-cores) is hidden behind Attributes=1, so guides that set only CPMINCORES leave every P-core parking. Higher class number = higher performance: Class 1 is P-cores, Class 0 is E-cores.
tweaks.evidence: 16 of 32 cores parked (exactly threads 0-15, all P-cores) before fix; 0 parked after.
tweaks.prerequisite: Set Attributes=2 on the setting key to unhide it first.

tweaks.name: Core parking min cores, Efficiency Class 0 (E-cores)
tweaks.reason: Standard core parking disable. On non-hybrid CPUs this is the only class.

tweaks.name: IDLEDISABLE (processor idle disable)
tweaks.applies_when: form_factor == desktop AND no WHEA errors present
tweaks.reason: Cores never enter sleep states, removing wake latency. Costs idle power and heat.
tweaks.warning: Do NOT apply on a laptop - destroys battery life and thermals. Do NOT apply if WHEA errors are present; it will expose marginal CPU stability.

tweaks.name: Win32PrioritySeparation
tweaks.reason: Short quantum with foreground boost. Standard competitive value.

tweaks.name: OverlayTestMode (disable Multi-Plane Overlay)
tweaks.reason: Fixes DWM stutter and flicker.
tweaks.warning: Location matters. The same value under HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\GraphicsDrivers is INERT. A tweak pack wrote it there and reported success for weeks.

tweaks.name: Ndu service (Network Data Usage monitor)
tweaks.reason: Documented DPC latency contributor. Only powers the Settings > Data usage page.

tweaks.name: Tcp1323Opts
tweaks.reason: Setting it to 0 disables TCP window scaling. Actively harmful on gigabit+ links. Frequently recommended as a 'latency' tweak.

tweaks.name: NtfsMemoryUsage
tweaks.reason: Raises paged-pool pressure for no measurable gain.

tweaks.name: WaitToKillServiceTimeout
tweaks.reason: Aggressive values force-kill slow services at shutdown for zero in-game benefit.
tweaks.gotcha: Windows reads this as REG_SZ only. Written as REG_DWORD it is silently ignored - it reads back correctly but does nothing. Always check GetValueKind, not just the value.

tweaks.name: HungAppTimeout / AutoEndTasks
tweaks.reason: Aggressive values (1000/1) can force-kill the game during a brief shader-compile hang. Zero FPS benefit. These are Windows defaults.

tweaks.name: LowLevelHooksTimeout
tweaks.reason: Unlike the other kill timeouts, this one IS an input-path tweak - it drops a hung mouse or keyboard hook faster (Discord overlay, RTSS).

tweaks.name: Pointer precision off (1:1 mouse)
tweaks.reason: Removes acceleration. Essential for consistent aim.

tweaks.name: bcdedit useplatformclock
tweaks.reason: Forces HPET. Actively harmful on modern Intel/AMD. Leaving it unset is correct. Widely recommended by older guides.

tweaks.name: NetworkThrottlingIndex = 0xFFFFFFFF
tweaks.reason: Fully disabling removes the network stack's DPC pacing for no measured gain. With SystemResponsiveness=0 the throttle window is already minimal. Use the Windows default of 10.
tweaks.note: This value being written by two different tweak packs with different numbers was one half of the conflict that made system state non-deterministic.

tweaks.name: Pin game to a subset of cores (e.g. affinity 0x555)
tweaks.reason: Catastrophic on a many-threaded CPU. Windows Thread Director handles hybrid scheduling better than a static mask.

tweaks.name: Disable E-cores in BIOS
tweaks.reason: TechPowerUp's 53-game test found it mostly a wash. Pinning background applications to E-cores is strictly better than disabling them.

tweaks.name: TdrDelay / TdrDdiDelay / TdrLevel
tweaks.reason: No FPS benefit. Raising TdrDelay only delays recovery from a GPU hang. The source pack's own logs contradicted themselves (4/4/3 vs 8/8/3).

tweaks.name: csrss.exe IFEO PerfOptions
tweaks.reason: csrss already runs at high priority. No measurable gain from forcing it.

tweaks.name: AFD DefaultReceiveWindow / DefaultSendWindow
tweaks.reason: Harmless but placebo for UDP games - these are TCP socket buffers.

tweaks.name: Fortnite Engine.ini overlay, set read-only
tweaks.reason: Fortnite deletes Engine.ini on exit and regenerates it on launch. Writing at logon and restoring on exit both fail. Setting the file read-only is the only approach that survives.

tweaks.name: r.OneFrameThreadLag=0 / r.GTSyncType=1
tweaks.reason: Saves roughly one frame of input lag by preventing CPU run-ahead. Measured cost: 480 FPS to 300-400. At 500Hz that is 2.08ms/frame vs 3.33ms/frame - it charges 1.25ms on every frame to save one frame once. Net loss at high refresh.
tweaks.note: May still be worth it at 60-144Hz where frame time dominates differently. Measure on your own display.

not_a_pc_problem.finding: 330 Mbps peaks mid-match spiking ping to 500-800ms. Windows cannot rate-limit inbound traffic; the queue fills upstream at the ISP, past the NIC. No registry value affects this.
not_a_pc_problem.fix: Router-level SQM/QoS, or eliminate the source of the traffic.

not_a_pc_problem.finding: MoUsoCoreWorker downloads at full line speed with no regard for foreground applications.
not_a_pc_problem.fix: Delivery Optimization bandwidth caps, or disable wuauserv + UsoSvc + DoSvc + WaaSMedicSvc. WaaSMedicSvc is the self-heal service that silently re-enables the others.
not_a_pc_problem.tradeoff: Disabling updates means no security patches. State it explicitly to the user.
